description: W42 watchtower run edits (workflows/watchtower/workflow.md, steps/weekly-step-02-draft-angles.md, steps/weekly-step-04-weekly-note.md) embedded a multi-sentence KNOWN BUG postmortem about the Obsidian MCP path-encoding bug, repeating it near-verbatim across all three files and hardcoding the absolute vault path 6 times. The bug record belongs in state.yaml (obsidian_write_method) and the error log only. The edits also left weekly-step-02 rule 8's verification gate still referencing mcp__obsidian-local__get_vault_file, contradicting the new rule 5 above it.
correction: Strip the bug narrative, Desktop Commander write-order instructions, and hardcoded vault paths from all workflow files. The operational record stays in state.yaml (obsidian_write_method: desktop-commander-direct) and the error log. Workflow files carry at most a one-line pointer to the state field.
systemic_fix: Rule of thumb for workflow edits: incident detail goes to the error log, not workflow files. A workflow file records how to run, not what broke. If a workaround needs recording, it goes in state as a single field.
